integrity.original_claim: Sharp fixed-mean heterogeneity bias envelope and convex-order sign, not the known GTFT pair-payoff formula or multinomial stationary law.
integrity.priority_risk: Generic convex-order theorems and earlier repeated-game payoff averaging results might imply parts; independent priority evaluation not performed.
integrity.proof_dependency: Absolute moment expansion of explicitly stated four-state discounted payoff matrix; no numerical evidence is used as an infinite proof.

scientific_limitations: Repeated donation games with s1=1/2, 0<delta<1 and iid generosity; no claim for assortative matching, time-varying strategy laws, other one-shot payoff matrices, or evolutionary optimality.
title: Sharp heterogeneous-generosity payoff envelope for repeated donation games
